scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @wqi/contracts" "npm run dev -w @wqi/server" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @wqi/client"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run dev -w @wqi/client
scripts.dev:wqi: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,ai,api,web "npm run dev -w @wqi/contracts" "npm run ai:dev" "node scripts/run-local-api.mjs" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @wqi/client"
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run build -w @wqi/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run build -w @wqi/server && npm run build -w @wqi/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:local: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run db:local -w @wqi/server
scripts.admin:create: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run admin:create -w @wqi/server
